description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information about hospital admissions for patients in the database. It includes patient identifiers, admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, discharge locations, insurance details, demographic information (language, religion, marital status, ethnicity), diagnosis, and flags indicating in-hospital mortality and the availability of data in the CHARTEVENTS table. This table provides a comprehensive overview of each patient's hospital stay.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient identifier, unique across the entire MIMIC-III database.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: The date and time of the patient's death, if it occurred during the hospital stay. Null if the patient did not die during the admission.

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the patient prior to admission.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: The location to which the patient was discharged (e.g., Home, Skilled Nursing Facility).

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: The type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: The primary language of the patient.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was registered in the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient left the emergency department (ED).

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The primary diagnosis for the patient's admission.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient expired in the hospital (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether or not the patient's admission has corresponding data in the CHARTEVENTS table (1) or not (0).
